data.title: Nothing to seal here: NZ police help stranded pup home
data.description: WELLINGTON — New Zealand police came to the rescue of a seal crossing a busy road, helping the perplexed pinniped pup back safely into the water, they said Monday.

data.title: Seoul seeks apology after Ukraine reveals transfer of North Korean POWs
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's presidential office has demanded an apology from Ukraine for denying an agreement to keep the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul confidential.

data.title: 'Currently impossible': North Korea defections in freefall
data.description: PAJU (SOUTH KOREA) - A building-sized North Korean flag waves from a tower on the de facto border with South Korea, marking territory that experts say has become nearly impossible to escape.

data.title: Pseudo-journalism: Partisan 'news' sites target US midterms
data.description: WASHINGTON - It bills itself as an "independent journalism" outfit, but the innocuous-sounding North Carolinian is among hundreds of partisan sites that researchers say masquerade as local news outlets in battleground states ahead of the US midterm elections.

data.title: Wife of Malaysia's longest-serving PM Mahathir dies at 100
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Siti ⁠Hasmah Mohamad Ali, the wife ​of Malaysia's longest-serving prime minister Mahathir Mohamad, died on Monday, ​the veteran leader's office said.

data.title: Pope to speak on united Europe from French border town
data.description: METZ (FRANCE) - Pope Leo was to speak on Monday about the future of Europe and its integration, giving a distinctly political dimension to a landmark visit to France, which has sparked scenes of spiritual jubilation.

data.title: Washington denounces Iran's truce proposal as 'cynical'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A top US official on Sunday dismissed a proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz presented by Iran as "cynical" and indicated it was a non-starter for Washington.

data.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 8
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes killed eight people across Ukraine a day after Moscow vowed to achieve its war aims "no matter the circumstances", authorities said Sunday.

data.title: UK village on edge over threats to air base in terror alert
data.description: CIRENCESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Residents in a bucolic corner of southwestern England said they were "spooked" by an air base used by the US military in its war against Iran as bomb experts descended on the area on Sunday.

data.title: Serbia's President Aleksandar Vucic announces resignation
data.description: BELGRADE - Serbia's long-time populist President Aleksandar Vucic resigned Sunday to run for prime minister in October snap elections after nearly two years of student-led protests that had been pressing for just such a poll.

data.title: Aleksandar Vucic: from Milosevic minister to long-serving Serbian statesman
data.description: BELGRADE - The dominant force in Serbian politics for over 14 years, Aleksandar Vucic climbed from the wreckage of strongman Slobodan Milosevic's cabinet to the centre of power using his brand of populist nationalism.

data.title: UK police arrest five for preparing 'terrorist act' as incident near air base probed
data.description: FAIRFORD (UNITED KINGDOM) - British counter-terrorism police were Sunday probing "a major" incident near a base used by the US air force after arresting five men on suspicion of "preparing a terrorist act", police said.

data.title: Gunmen kill 27 in two shootings in South Africa
data.description: JOHANNESBURG - Gunmen killed at least 27 people in two mass shootings in South Africa's two main cities, Johannesburg and Cape Town, police said on Sunday, in the latest criminal violence to hit the country.

data.title: UK police call in bomb disposal team near air force base
data.description: LONDON - British police on Sunday declared a major incident and evacuated villagers living near a base used by the US air force after arresting several men on suspicion of explosives offences.

data.title: Bangkok floods send thousands into shelters after days of rain
data.description: Deep floodwaters in Bangkok have driven thousands of residents into shelters as others scrambled to buy groceries or dry out their homes after days of heavy rain inundated markets, roads and residences.

data.title: Thousands seek to thwart disputed N.Ireland flashpoint parade
data.description: PORTADOWN (UNITED KINGDOM) - Thousands gathered Sunday in a Northern Irish town seeking to halt a contentious pro-British Protestant march from passing through a mainly Catholic and nationalist area for the first time in 28 years.

data.title: UK Labour party meets buoyed by Burnham but eager for concrete plans
data.description: LIVERPOOL - Britain's ruling Labour Party gathers Sunday for its first annual conference under Andy Burnham's leadership, heartened by his start as prime minister but now looking for concrete plans to tackle looming challenges.

data.title: Swiss vote on what it means to be neutral
data.description: GENEVA - The Swiss are voting Sunday on a much-debated proposal to tighten their country's cherished neutrality, with polls indicating most will reject the initiative championed by the hard-right and dubbed "pro-Russian" by opponents.

data.title: Thousands protest ahead of Mexican president's report on missing students
data.description: MEXICO CITY - Thousands of protesters wore red and carried symbolic coffins during a demonstration in Mexico City on Saturday, demanding answers about the 43 trainee teachers who went missing 12 years ago.

data.title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters
data.description: BANGKOK - Thousands of Bangkok residents awoke in shelters on Sunday after flooding triggered by days of heavy rain in the Thai capital inundated homes and roads, with some starting to dry out their homes and belongings.

data.title: Japanese anime actor fights TikTok over AI voice cloning
data.description: TOKYO - A high-profile Japanese anime voice actor has taken TikTok to court over videos he says feature an artificial intelligence clone of his "lustrous" baritone, with a verdict due on Wednesday.

data.title: Venezuela releases more political prisoners after opposition talks
data.description: CARACAS - More than three dozen political prisoners were released between Friday and Saturday, a rights group reported, after US-backed talks between Venezuela's interim government and the opposition.

data.title: Thousands march in Madrid over eviction of 87-year-old woman
data.description: MADRID - Thousands of people marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest the eviction earlier this week of an 87-year-old woman from her lifelong home, calling for greater protection for tenants.

data.title: At least 16 killed in Russian and Ukrainian strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian and Ukrainian strikes killed at least 16 people over the last 24 hours, both countries said Saturday, with the war still raging in its fifth year.

data.title: Russia accuses Europe of seeking to thwart Ukraine talks
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov accused Europe Saturday of "doing everything" to thwart talks to resolve the conflict between Moscow and Kyiv, in an outspoken UN speech in which he vowed his country would achieve its Ukraine aims.

data.title: Giant statue of Pope Leo XIV takes shape in Peru workshop
data.description: LIMA - A giant clay sculpture of Pope Leo XIV's head takes shape in a workshop in Peru's capital, as the Andean nation prepares for the pontiff's visit in November.

data.title: China and US agree on $30bn tariff cuts, Beijing says
data.description: SHANGHAI - China said on ​Saturday it had agreed with the United States on a $30-billion ​reciprocal tariff-reduction arrangement and on launching ‌a dialogue on artificial intelligence, under an eight-point consensus reached during President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.

data.title: Pope preaches ‘dignity and peace’ in Paris
data.description: PARIS - Pope Leo XIV said on Saturday it was possible to “live together in dignity and peace” as he met migrants in Paris, ahead of a giant open-air mass expected to gather hundreds of thousands of people on the iconic Champs Elysees.

data.title: Nepal tunnel survivor wants to help post-flood rebuild
data.description: KIRTIPUR , Nepal - Pulled alive 10 days after catastrophic floods trapped him in a tunnel, Nepali hydropower worker Kabir Maharjan is determined to help rebuild his country despite his own harrowing ordeal.

data.title: Indonesia fires threaten critically endangered orangutans
data.description: JAKARTA - Wildfires that tore through Indonesian Borneo's vast tropical forests have piled pressure on critically endangered Bornean orangutans, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) said on Saturday.
